records.reason: Lets you Sustain a battle aura for free after a hit — an action-economy substitution resolved at the table; no sheet statistic changes.
A two-action activity where the eidolon and you each Strike; only the MAP timing changes, and that is resolved at the table.
A reaction that lets you attempt a Grapple; an action resolved at the table.
A one-action ability offering table-resolved options (Recall Knowledge, Step, Reposition, Demoralize) with skill substitutions the GM adjudicates.
A reaction Strike triggered by an ally's attack; MAP exemption and damage pooling are resolved at the table.
An amp that changes only the spell target's situation (recurring damage on the target); nothing on the caster's sheet.
Treats your spotter's position as your own for cover and range on the next Strike — positional, GM-adjudicated, not a sheet statistic.
A one-action Strike that ignores concealment and cover; an action resolved at the table.
Grants extra precision damage to the NEXT creature other than you that attacks the target — an ally-side benefit.
A one-action Strike that also Taunts the target; an action resolved at the table.
Extends Change Shape to object forms with narrative restrictions the GM adjudicates; no statistic changes.
Pure communication/awareness with your companion; no mechanical statistic.
A one-action mythic Strike whose extra damage dice depend on Mythic Points spent after the roll; resolved at the table.
Changes what an Elemental Medicine you prepare does for its RECIPIENT during a downtime activity the app does not model.

The feat permanently gives your familiar the Path of the Tempest familiar ability (an activation that grants YOU a +10-foot status bonus to Speed, reaction-free Striding and a Long Jump without a Stride). The record carries nothing and the familiar's ability roster never shows it; the COMPANION_MODS registry is the existing lane for feats that modify an existing companion.

companionMod.note: Tempest Cloud's Speed: your familiar gains the Path of the Tempest familiar ability (once per 10 minutes: you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed until the end of your turn, don't trigger reactions when you Stride this turn, and don't need to Stride before a Long Jump). Requires that you aren't encumbered.

records.reason: Upgrades the area and damage of the Storming Gaze action at the moment you use it; an action resolved at the table.
A spellshape action that reduces your spell's damage to chosen targets and reduces damage those targets later deal you — per-cast and resolved at the table.
A reaction that expends a slot to reduce one instance of triggering damage; resolved at the table.
A one-action self-concealment for 1 round that explicitly can't be used to Hide or Sneak; concealment is not a tracked sheet statistic.
A two-action Strike/Step/Strike activity costing a Mythic Point; resolved at the table.
A save attempted at the moment your character would die; the dying threshold itself is unchanged, so the dyingThresholdBonus lane doesn't apply and there is no persistent statistic.
Changes only how your animal companion's drop to 0 HP is resolved at the table (stays up at 1 HP, becomes wounded 1); no companion statistic changes.

"Your jaws unarmed attack gains the grapple trait" — a permanent trait added to an unarmed Strike you already have, which is exactly the unarmedTraits lane; the record carries nothing, so the jaws Strike shows no grapple trait. (The Breath of the Dragon degree-of-success rider is target-side and stays unmodelled.)
Raises the DC a TARGET faces to Escape/Force Open your net and leaves the target off-guard; entirely target-side.
Extends the maximum duration of poisons you create, affecting the afflicted victim; poison durations aren't tracked on the sheet.

Grants the critical specialization effect with every weapon from Tengu Weapon Familiarity, and the legacy record carries no critSpec at all. The remaster Tengu Weapon Familiarity record already encodes exactly this weapon set (critSpec + critSpecWeapons {traits:[tengu], bases:[katana, khakkara, temple-sword, wakazashi]}); mirror it here so the legacy feat isn't inert.
A degree-of-success upgrade on Make an Impression plus permission to Request of unfriendly creatures; social adjudication, no bonus or statistic.
A spellshape that changes the difficult-terrain state of adjacent squares; battlefield state the GM tracks.
Adds a blood magic effect that alters terrain around you; battlefield state, no sheet statistic.
Makes other creatures off-guard to you under terrain conditions — a target-side condition the GM applies.
Permanent Vanishing Tracks and concealment inside a GM-defined favored location; concealment and tracking aren't sheet statistics.
Lets you swap your favored terrain with a 1-hour exploration activity; the choice itself is already made by the Favored Terrain feat and the swap is table/downtime bookkeeping.
A reaction granting resistance to physical damage against one triggering Strike, once per 10 minutes; a one-shot reaction, not a standing resistance.
Adds a Demoralize against each enemy when you use Ursine Avenger Form; an action resolved at the table with target-side effects.
Adds the fleeing condition to the TARGET on a critical Demoralize; target-side only.
A one-action Demoralize variant with a target-side frightened floor; the language penalty waiver is a check-time adjustment the GM applies.

Grants the PLAYER a standing resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from Strikes made by frightened creatures, equal to four times that attacker's frightened value. Nothing delivers it: the resistances field is unconditional and its value can only reference the actor, so there is no way to key a resistance to the ATTACKER's condition value (and a flat resistance here would be a large over-grant).
Skill substitution and a crit-fail upgrade for Decipher Writing, an exploration/downtime activity the app doesn't model.
Ceases aging, changes what detection effects read you as, and teaches three Create Undead rituals; rituals and creature-detection categories aren't tracked on the sheet.
A two-action cursebound ability summoning ghostly warriors that make their own Strikes; resolved at the table.
Deals damage to a foe you successfully Trip; damage to the target, resolved at the table.
Duplicate Player Core printing of the same Trip damage rider; damage to the target, resolved at the table.
Ceases aging, changes what detection effects read you as, and teaches the Control Weather and Plant Growth rituals (usable with Occultism); rituals aren't tracked on the sheet.
A three-action kineticist impulse dealing area damage and creating difficult terrain; resolved at the table.

A two-action ability that turns on a 1-minute self-buff giving resistance to ALL damage equal to half your level, plus reach and +2d6 vitality/void on your melee Strikes and escalating drained — a textbook toggleable mode, and the record carries nothing.

mode.name: The Tyrant Falls!
mode.note: The Tyrant Falls!: at the start of each of your turns you become drained 1 or increase your drained value by 1, and you can't reduce or remove drained while this is active — but drained doesn't penalize your Fortitude save while it lasts. You can cast Invoke the Crimson Oath at will without spending Focus Points (with an increased area). Any melee weapon you wield gains the reach trait (or +5 feet of reach if it already had reach) and its Strikes deal an extra 2d6 vitality or void damage, whichever is more effective against the target.

records.reason: A one-action summon of an inactive undead companion's fragment to give a support benefit; resolved at the table.

The permanent benefit is delivered: the core.json record carries maxHpBonus {"flat":20} for the +20 maximum Hit Points. The remaining rider (resistance 10 to physical until the start of your next turn after casting a self-only non-cantrip spell) is a per-cast, one-round effect resolved at the table.
On a critical Hellbreaker Strike the TARGET saves or is stunned; target-side only.
Adds persistent piercing damage to the target on a critical seedpod Strike; damage to the target, resolved at the table.
The GM gives extra information on successful Recall Knowledge checks; pure GM adjudication.

A free action giving 1 minute of flat-check and hidden/concealed relief within 30 feet and imprecise senses beyond; perception-state handling resolved at the table, not a sense the senses field can express (it would falsely grant a precise sense).
A one-action ability dealing damage to a grabbed enemy with a save; damage to the target, resolved at the table.
Sanctification with the holy trait plus Occultism substitutions for the Subsist downtime activity and Treat Wounds during Refocus; downtime/GM-side, and no aging is pure flavour.
An item-storage flavour ability with Interact actions to use it; no statistic changes.
Forces a grabbed TARGET to roll its divine-action flat check twice and take the worse result, with damage to that target; target-side only.
A spellshape that denies targets the cover provided by intervening creatures for your next spell attack; per-cast, resolved at the table.
A weapon ikon whose only mechanical content in the record is the 2-action Blinding of the Needle transcendence — an action resolved at the table; no passive immanence text to model.
A three-action mythic activity: a temporary thrown trait for one Strike plus a follow-up melee Strike; resolved at the table.
A two-action cone attack with a save and a recharge; damage and deafening apply to targets, resolved at the table.
A spellshape adding deafened/prone riders to creatures that failed the spell's Reflex save; target-side only.
